2608.12273.title: Convergent Detour Hijacking: Task-Preserving Resource Amplification in Skill-Based LLM Agents
2608.12273.paper_summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on third-party skills, using natural-language descriptions for selection and instruction bodies for planning. This progressive-disclosure design exposes two sequential control points to untrusted publishers: a static skill may steer an otherwise correct task onto an unnecessarily costly trajectory. Prior work studies selection manipulation, malicious skill instructions, and tool-chain resource amplification largely separately, leaving their end-to-end composition unclear. We introduce Convergent Detour Hijacking (CDH), a text-only, runtime-independent attack that couples these stages. Under shared semantic cover, a description establishes relevance during selection, while an aligned body reuses that rationale to fabricate plausible dependencies during planning. CDH attracts an attacker-controlled coordinator alongside legitimate skills, recruits unnecessary benign skills into a bounded detour, and then re-enters the original route to preserve task completion. We evaluate it across multiple LLM backends and 491 held-out tasks under single-task and multi-turn conditions. On DeepSeek-V4-Pro, the matched coordinator is selected in 80.02% of tasks; among coordinator-hit runs that complete tasks, token consumption and end-to-end execution time increase by 66.91% and 92.45%, respectively, while aggregate task completion remains comparable. Thus, correct outcomes do not guarantee trajectory integrity or cost safety.
2608.12273.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理越來越依賴第三方技能，使用自然語言描述來進行選擇，並使用指令主體進行規劃。這種漸進式揭露設計向不受信任的出版者暴露了兩個連續的控制點：靜態技能可能會將本來正確的任務引導到不必要的高成本軌跡上。先前的研究主要分開研究了選擇操控、惡意技能指令和工具鏈資源擴增，導致它們的端到端組合不明確。我們引入了收斂繞道劫持（CDH），這是一種僅限文本的、與運行時間無關的攻擊，將這些階段結合在一起。在共享語義的掩護下，描述在選擇過程中建立了相關性，而對應的主體則重用該理由，在規劃過程中製造出可信的依賴關係。CDH 吸引了一個由攻擊者控制的協調者，與合法技能一起工作，招募不必要的良性技能進入一個有限的繞道，然後重新進入原始路徑以保證任務完成。我們在多個 LLM 後端和 491 個保留任務下，對其進行了單任務和多回合條件的評估。在 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上，匹配的協調者在 80.02% 的任務中被選中；在完成任務的協調者命中運行中，令牌消耗和端到端執行時間分別增加了 66.91% 和 92.45%，而總體任務完成率仍然相當。因此，正確的結果並不保證軌跡的完整性或成本的安全性。
